mechanism: 해외 정치위험 노출의 변화가 차입 수요·부채 이용 비용·자금조달 구조 경로를 통해 기업 재무레버리지의 감소로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R02084의 적용 맥락: This evidence examines U.S. multinational parent firms (BEA data, benchmark years 1982, 1989, 1994, 1999) where the outcome is firm‑wide leverage (sum of parent and affiliate borrowing divided by total parent+affiliate assets). Exposure is measured at the parent level as the share of firm sales in countries with above‑median ICRG political risk (ICRG rescaled 0–1). Table 7 reports OLS panel regressions (parent-year) that include industry and year fixed effects and cluster standard errors by parent.

원자료 R02085의 적용 맥락: Using BEA benchmark-survey data (1982, 1989, 1994, 1999), the paper analyzes U.S. parent firms (parent-level unit) to relate their exposure to foreign political risk — measured as the share of firm sales, employment, or net PPE located in countries with above-median ICRG political risk (rescaled 0–1) — to parent domestic leverage (parent current liabilities and long-term debt over parent assets). Parent-level regressions are OLS panel specifications with industry and year fixed effects and standard errors clustered by parent.
